title: The Principle of Superposition
text:
Quantum superposition is a fundamental concept stating that a quantum system exists in multiple states simultaneously until it is observed or measured. Before measurement, the particle's state is described by a weighted sum of all possible measurable outcomes.

This duality contrasts with classical mechanics, where an object must possess definite properties at all times. The act of observation causes the wave function to collapse, forcing the system to select one specific, observable state from its potential spectrum.
